ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_RefRowLevelSecurityAudit] AS BEGIN

WITH SRC AS (
    select
    UserID as UserID
    ,UserName as UserName
    ,UserGroup as UserGroup
    ,UserEmail as UserEmail
    ,BankID as BankID
    ,SourceSystemCode as SourceSystemCode
    ,Datalayer as datalayer
    ,getdate() as ValidStartDttm
    ,'9999-12-31'	as ValidEndDttm
    ,WorkFlowId as WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId as TaskRunId
    ,getdate() as InsertDttm
    ,BINARY_CHECKSUM(UserName,UserGroup,BankID,SourceSystemCode,datalayer) as DimensionChksm
    FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurity WHERE USERID IN ('fvffuentebella','cjsledres','ktbaliton')
)
SELECT * INTO #SRC FROM SRC;



WITH TGT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'  AND  USERID IN ('fvffuentebella','cjsledres','ktbaliton')
)
, DELTA AS (
    SELECT 
     COALESCE(S.UserID,T.UserID) UserID
    ,COALESCE(S.UserEmail,T.UserEmail) UserEmail
    ,COALESCE(S.BankID,T.BankID) BankID
    ,COALESCE(S.SourceSystemCode,T.SourceSystemCode) SourceSystemCode
    ,S.DimensionChksm as src_dchksm
    ,T.DimensionChksm as tgt_dchksm,
    CASE WHEN T.DimensionChksm IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
         WHEN S.DimensionChksm IS NULL THEN 'DELETE'
         WHEN S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm THEN 'UPDATE'
         ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #SRC S
    FULL OUTER JOIN TGT T ON S.UserID = T.UserID AND S.UserEmail = T.UserEmail AND S.UserName = T.UserName AND S.UserGroup = T.UserGroup AND S.BankID = T.BankID  AND S.SourceSystemCode = T.SourceSystemCode 
    --WHERE T.DimensionChksm IS NULL OR S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm OR S.DimensionChksm IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #DELTA FROM DELTA;
SELECT * FROM #DELTA

UPDATE TGT
SET 
ValidEndDttm=getdate(),  
InsertDttm=getdate()
FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit  TGT
JOIN #DELTA DELTA ON TGT.UserID = DELTA.UserID AND TGT.UserEmail = DELTA.UserEmail AND TGT.BankID = DELTA.BankID AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31' AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','DELETE');


INSERT INTO dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit (UserID,UserName,UserGroup,UserEmail,BankID,SourceSystemCode,Datalayer,ValidStartDttm,ValidEndDttm,WorkFlowId,TaskRunId,InsertDttm,DimensionChksm)
SELECT distinct
SRC.UserID
,SRC.UserName
,SRC.UserGroup
,SRC.UserEmail
,SRC.BankID
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.Datalayer
,SRC.ValidStartDttm
,SRC.ValidEndDttm
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
,SRC.DimensionChksm
FROM #SRC SRC
JOIN #DELTA DELTA ON SRC.UserID = DELTA.UserID AND SRC.UserEmail = DELTA.UserEmail AND SRC.BankID = DELTA.BankID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS in ( 'UPDATE' , 'INSERT') AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit B WHERE B.ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
    AND SRC.UserID = B.UserID
    AND SRC.UserName = B.UserName
    AND SRC.UserGroup = B.UserGroup
    AND SRC.UserEmail = B.UserEmail
    AND SRC.BankID = B.BankID
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    AND SRC.Datalayer = B.Datalayer
    AND SRC.DimensionChksm = B.DimensionChksm
);

END

ALTER PROCEDURE DW.SP_RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit
AS BEGIN

WITH SRC AS (
    select
UserEmail as UserEmail
,BankSk as BankSk
,BankID as BankID
,SourceSystemCode as SourceSystemCode
,getdate() as ValidStartDttm
,'9999-12-31'	as ValidEndDttm
,isnull(WorkFlowId,0) as WorkFlowId
,isnull(TaskRunId,0) as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
,BINARY_CHECKSUM(UserEmail,BankSk,BankID,SourceSystemCode) as DimensionChksm
     FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter
)
SELECT * INTO #SRC FROM SRC;

WITH TGT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
)
, DELTA AS (
    SELECT 
     COALESCE(S.BankSk,T.BankSk) BankSk
    ,COALESCE(S.UserEmail,T.UserEmail) UserEmail
    ,COALESCE(S.BankID,T.BankID) BankID
    ,COALESCE(S.SourceSystemCode,T.SourceSystemCode) SourceSystemCode
    ,S.DimensionChksm as src_dchksm
    ,T.DimensionChksm as tgt_dchksm,
    CASE WHEN T.DimensionChksm IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
         WHEN S.DimensionChksm IS NULL THEN 'DELETE'
         WHEN S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm THEN 'UPDATE'
         ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #SRC S
    FULL OUTER JOIN TGT T ON S.BankSk = T.BankSk AND S.UserEmail = T.UserEmail AND S.BankID = T.BankID  AND S.SourceSystemCode = T.SourceSystemCode 
    WHERE T.DimensionChksm IS NULL OR S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm OR S.DimensionChksm IS NULL
) 

SELECT * INTO #DELTA FROM DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET 
ValidEndDttm=getdate(),  
InsertDttm=getdate()
FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit  TGT
JOIN #DELTA DELTA ON TGT.BankSk = DELTA.BankSk AND TGT.UserEmail = DELTA.UserEmail AND TGT.BankID = DELTA.BankID AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31' AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','DELETE');


INSERT INTO dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit 
SELECT DISTINCT
 SRC.UserEmail
,SRC.BankSk
,SRC.BankID
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.ValidStartDttm
,SRC.ValidEndDttm
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
,SRC.DimensionChksm
FROM #SRC SRC
JOIN #DELTA DLT ON SRC.BankSk = DLT.BankSk AND SRC.UserEmail = DLT.UserEmail AND SRC.BankID = DLT.BankID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = DLT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE 
DLT.RECORD_STATUS in ( 'UPDATE' , 'INSERT')
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit B WHERE B.ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
    AND SRC.UserEmail = B.UserEmail
    AND SRC.BankSk = B.BankSk
    AND SRC.BankID = B.BankID
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    AND SRC.DimensionChksm = B.DimensionChksm
);
END
